d: Strong technical experience in GIS switchgear is required. The role includes performing E&C services and maintenance activities, including testing and commissioning of all types of high voltage switchgear. The candidate must be able to handle and manage GIS equipment, prepare technical reports and site documentation, and ensure full EHS compliance and quality of site work in accordance with GE Vernova procedures.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Electronics, and/or Electromechanical Engineering or relevant field, or/and diploma in a relevant field from an accredited university or college.
Minimum 5 years of experience in high voltage switch gears.
Capable to do GIS SS site services included maintenance (preventive and corrective)
Experienced good to use MS 365 & Projects etc.
Required multiple working remote sites in Kuwait
Strong oral and written communication skills. Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs.
Good Interpersonal skills, quick learner & leadership skills.
Good conduct & having Excellent communication skills.
Managing the site and customer needs well even in pressure environment
r: li
Fully understand the importance of site safety and perform LOTO operations in compliance with GE and customer safety regulations
li
Implement GEV EHS rules by understanding and applying site Safety, Quality, and Productivity standards for continuous improvement
li
Perform E&C activities for GIS 132 kV and 300 kV substations
li
Execute troubleshooting and corrective repairs in live electrical substations
li
Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance activities of GIS as per approved procedures
li
Read and interpret electrical and mechanical drawings to diagnose equipment issues
li
Perform scheduled preventive maintenance of GIS substations
li
Maintain accurate back‑office reporting, test reports, and customer site documentation
li
Coordinate with OEMs and factories for resolution of unresolved repair issues and non‑conformities (NCs)
li
Provide technical assistance during installation, pre‑arrangement, and project execution phases
li
Work effectively as part of a site team or act as a site lead, including task allocation and coordination of site personnel.
